about: Incorporated in 2016 after the merger of Praveg Communications Limited with Sword and Shield Pharma limited; Praveg Communications (India) Limited is an advertising company with core competence in Exhibition and Event Management. The company is also engaged into providing services to the Hospitality sector, Publications and Real Estate marketing. The company has set up its branches nationally and internationally.
